original_ai_output.title_zh: 联合国警告维和人员不宜过早撤离中非共和国
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国驻中非共和国最高官员在安理会警告称，MINUSCA维和人员若过早撤离，可能危及近期取得的进展。她指出，邻国苏丹的战争正加剧中非东部边境地区的不稳定。她还提到6月30日边境城镇Am-Dafock遭武装团体袭击，造成平民和安全人员死亡、1.7万人流离失所、6名维和人员受伤。

key_facts.fact: 联合国驻中非共和国最高官员警告MINUSCA维和人员不宜过早撤离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The United Nations’ top official in the Central African Republic on Tuesday warned against the premature withdrawal of MINUSCA peacekeepers from the country.

key_facts.fact: 苏丹战争加剧中非东部边境地区的不稳定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the war in neighbouring Sudan fuels instability along its eastern borders

key_facts.fact: 6月30日边境城镇Am-Dafock遭武装团体袭击，造成平民和安全人员死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a 30 June attack on the border town of Am‑Dafock where an armed group killed civilians and security personnel

key_facts.fact: 袭击导致1.7万人流离失所，6名维和人员受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: displaced 17,000 people, and wounded six peacekeepers

uncertainties: 事件细节来自单一来源（Africanews），尚缺乏交叉验证
